patterns.note: Full-width hero sections feature large, aspirational product photography as a background, with content (logo, navigation, text) overlaid, creating an immersive visual experience.

A distinctive warm terracotta/reddish-brown (#cf2e2e) is consistently used as a primary accent color, appearing in product packaging, background elements, and calls to action, creating a strong brand identity.
Main headings and key brand statements utilize a classic, elegant serif font, contrasting with a clean, legible sans-serif for body text and smaller labels, which are often uppercase.
Horizontal carousels (using swiper) are employed for displaying partner brand logos and potentially for product reviews, allowing users to interactively browse content without scrolling vertically.
No scroll-triggered reveal animations, parallax effects, or sticky elements were observed in the provided scroll sequence; the design relies on static hierarchy and content presentation.
Feature sections frequently employ a two-column split layout, alternating between image-left/text-right and text-left/image-right, to present product benefits and details with visual balance.

technique_notes: Hero sections are constructed with large, high-resolution product or lifestyle images set as full-bleed backgrounds, often with a subtle overlay to ensure text legibility.
Product listings are presented in a clean, responsive grid, where each item features a prominent product image, name, price, and a clear 'Select' button for interaction.
The site integrates a horizontal content slider (as indicated by 'swiper' tech) for elements like brand endorsements, allowing users to swipe through a series of logos or testimonials.

design_tokens.type_scale: Large, elegant serif headings (~3-4x body) with generous letter spacing, paired with clean, legible sans-serif body text and smaller, often uppercase sans-serif labels.
design_tokens.radius: Subtle; elements like buttons and input fields have a very slight rounding, almost sharp, while product images and section corners are typically sharp-edged.
design_tokens.spacing: Balanced; sections have ample vertical padding, creating an airy feel, while content within sections (like product grids) maintains a comfortable density.

standout: The site's most distinctive feature is its sophisticated and consistent use of a rich, warm terracotta color palette, which is deeply integrated into both the product packaging and the site's design elements. This strong color identity, combined with elegant serif typography and large-scale, editorial product photography, creates a luxurious and cohesive brand experience that feels premium and established.
